name: ng-add
description: Installs @angular/material, @angular/cdk, and @angular/animations, then runs a schematic that configures a theme, typography, and browser animations for the workspace.

options.name: theme
options.description: Prebuilt theme to install, or "custom" to generate a starter custom theme file instead.

options.name: typography
options.description: Add the Roboto font and Material typography styles to the project.

options.name: animations
options.description: Whether to set up @angular/animations: "enabled", "disabled" (adds NoopAnimationsModule), or "excluded" (skips the animations package entirely).

generatedFiles: angular.json (styles array updated with the chosen theme)
src/styles.scss or src/styles.css (theme import or mat.theme mixin added)
src/index.html (Roboto font and Material Icons links, if typography is enabled)
